item.title: Power Platform dependencies face April 1, 2027 cutoff for SharePoint temporary authentication URLs — 20 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 20 November 2026

Power Platform dependencies face April 1, 2027 cutoff for SharePoint temporary authentication URLs

SharePoint temporary authentication URLs will no longer be available from April 1, 2027, breaking dependent Power Apps and Power Automate functionality. Advanced Management guidance now covers group-based access reporting and adds a new Copilot-readiness path built around assessments, lifecycle management, and archiving. OneDrive deployment notes and Copilot availability terminology were also refreshed.

SharePoint · General

Power Platform dependencies face SharePoint URL retirement in April 2027

SharePoint temporary authentication URLs will no longer be available starting April 1, 2027. Power Apps and Power Automate functionality that relies on these URLs will break when they are retired.

Advanced Management · Reports and usage

Advanced Management guidance now covers group-based access reports

Updated guidance says data access governance reports support Microsoft 365 groups and Microsoft Entra security groups alongside users. Group reports accept up to 100 groups and exclude SharePoint groups, distribution lists, and permissions inherited through nested groups.

Advanced Management · AI and Copilot

New Advanced Management guidance connects Copilot readiness with site governance

A new article explains how Content Management Assessment, site lifecycle management, and archiving can identify overshared, inactive, or ownerless sites. Administrators can start assessments in the SharePoint admin center, review remediation recommendations, and rerun assessments every 30 days.

Agents and Copilot · AI and Copilot

Copilot availability guidance now names Site AI settings and Restricted Content Discovery

The updated Copilot article clarifies availability controls and references the November 1, 2026 transition to Site AI settings and Restricted Content Discovery, alongside revised terminology for advanced work and Copilot Credits.

OneDrive · General

OneDrive deferred-ring notes revise builds and January 2027 target

Sync release notes list newer Windows and Mac Deferred-ring builds, including 26.189.0928.0011 and candidate build 26.204.1019.0009, with a revised target date of January 18, 2027. The notes also record reliability and performance fixes.

item.title: SharePoint storage guidance expands around version trimming, archiving, and capacity — 19 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 19 November 2026

SharePoint storage guidance expands around version trimming, archiving, and capacity

Microsoft substantially expanded and retitled the SharePoint storage management guidance. The updated article brings together ways to assess storage usage, trim versions, archive inactive content, review deletion and retention, manage capacity, and control future growth. It also covers admin reports, SharePoint Admin Agent, and Microsoft Graph Data Connect as assessment approaches.

Content and versions · General

Expanded storage-remediation and capacity guidance

The retitled SharePoint storage management article now covers storage assessment, version trimming, inactive-content archiving, deletion and retention review, capacity management, and future-growth controls. It adds approaches using admin reports, SharePoint Admin Agent, and Microsoft Graph Data Connect. The guidance also calls out recoverability, retention, processing time, pay-as-you-go storage, and possible charges when choosing an approach.

item.title: Agent access heatmaps and manager-only sharing controls get new SharePoint preview guidance — 18 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 18 November 2026

Agent access heatmaps and manager-only sharing controls get new SharePoint preview guidance

New Agent 365 and SharePoint material centers on governing how agents reach and share content: the heatmap preview exposes access and sensitivity context, while a separate preview control can limit agentic-user sharing to managers. Message Center notices add two rollout tracks: Full Workload Backup across SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange through February 2027 general availability, and the Agent Chat web part worldwide through March 2027. Smaller edits update the Copilot plugins and agent registry link and refresh the restriction-setting screenshot.

Agents and Copilot · AI and Copilot

Heatmap overview maps agent access across SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams sites

The new preview article says the SharePoint admin center heatmap shows which SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and Teams-connected sites agents access, along with content ownership, sensitivity, and whether agents read, modify, or upload files. Full business-group and sensitivity views depend on business groups and sensitivity labels.

Agents and Copilot · Permissions and governance

Manager-only sharing restriction is an off-by-default Agent 365 preview

New guidance describes a tenant-level setting that restricts agentic users to sharing SharePoint and OneDrive content only with their managers. Administrators can apply it to all agent blueprint app IDs or selected IDs; the setting is off by default.

SharePoint · General

Full Workload Backup sets a single-policy rollout path through February 2027

Microsoft 365 Backup is introducing full-workload protection for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange under one policy. The rollout runs from July 2026 preview to February 2027 general availability, automates backup of all artifacts, preserves existing policies, and supports exclusions through CSV.

SharePoint · AI and Copilot

Agent Chat web part brings Copilot agents into SharePoint pages worldwide

The web part lets SharePoint authors embed Microsoft 365 Copilot agents in pages. Worldwide rollout is scheduled from November 2026 through March 2027; the message says no admin action is required, permissions remain separate, and no compliance impact is expected.

View all updates for 18 November 2026 →

item.title: SharePoint agents begin requiring upgrades as OneDrive shifts to cloud.microsoft URLs — 17 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 17 November 2026

SharePoint agents begin requiring upgrades as OneDrive shifts to cloud.microsoft URLs

Two updates carry the most operational weight. The SharePoint and OneDrive agent upgrade experience begins rolling out in mid-November 2026, and existing .agent files used in Teams or Microsoft Copilot will stop responding until upgraded. Separately, OneDrive URLs are transitioning from contoso-my.sharepoint.com to onedrive.cloud.microsoft between September 2026 and September 2027. The other changes are primarily guidance and maintenance: Application Restrictions cmdlet availability is still rolling out, Viva Connections home-site management is directed to the SharePoint admin center, sharing-link guidance is more precise, and OneDrive Sync release notes add two production builds.

Agents and Copilot · AI and Copilot

Agent upgrades will affect existing Teams and Copilot .agent files

The upgrade experience begins rolling out in mid-November 2026. Existing .agent files used in Teams or Microsoft Copilot will stop responding until upgraded. Teams chats require upgrading all agents together, and the SharePoint Agents icon and Main agent setting will be removed.

SharePoint · General

OneDrive URLs transition from SharePoint domains to cloud.microsoft

The transition from contoso-my.sharepoint.com to onedrive.cloud.microsoft starts in September 2026 and completes by September 2027. Both domains will coexist indefinitely, with no change to file access or APIs. Administrators should review custom solutions and documentation; no immediate action is required.

Agents and Copilot · AI and Copilot

Application Restrictions guidance flags tenant-dependent cmdlet availability

The Application Restrictions cmdlets are rolling out and may not yet be available in every tenant. The page also updates all listed PowerShell links to the Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell module path.

Sites and intranet · Planning and deployment

Viva Connections home-site management is directed to SharePoint admin center

Current setup guidance sends administrators to SharePoint admin center > Settings > Home sites to add, order, assign audiences to, and remove home sites. The Microsoft 365 admin center remains available as a legacy experience during the transition.

Sharing and permissions · General

Shareable-link guidance separates direct access from link-based sharing

The updated guidance distinguishes direct access from link-based sharing and covers hero links, audience scopes, forwarding, authentication, and access through search or Copilot. It gives administrators clearer material for evaluating internal, guest, and anonymous sharing scopes.

View all updates for 17 November 2026 →

item.title: Large-scale Teams events will add direct OneDrive video sharing via “Manage what attendees see” — 14 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 14 November 2026

Large-scale Teams events will add direct OneDrive video sharing via “Manage what attendees see”

The period’s main operational change is an upcoming Teams events capability that lets organizers and producers share OneDrive videos directly, avoiding screen sharing or PowerPoint embedding. Microsoft also says newly created Copilot Pages and Notebooks will be stored in OneDrive for Business, while updated OneDrive release notes document November builds and syncing behavior during Windows Game Mode.

SharePoint · Permissions and governance

Direct OneDrive video sharing is coming to large-scale Teams events

Organizers and producers will be able to use “Manage what attendees see” to share videos directly from OneDrive, providing playback without screen sharing or embedding in PowerPoint. Rollout starts in mid-November 2026; Microsoft recommends informing event staff and updating guidance, with no required action.

SharePoint · AI and Copilot

New Copilot Pages and Notebooks will be stored in OneDrive for Business

Starting in mid-October 2026, newly created Microsoft 365 Copilot Pages and Notebooks will use OneDrive for Business storage. Existing files remain unchanged, while governance, compliance, data protection, retention, and lifecycle-management features apply to the new files; no user action is required.

OneDrive · General

OneDrive release notes record November builds and Game Mode sync pauses

The updated release notes add November 2026 OneDrive builds, state that syncing pauses during Windows Game Mode and resumes afterward, and list reliability and performance fixes for recent Windows and macOS releases. No configuration change is stated.

View all updates for 14 November 2026 →

item.title: SharePoint temporary authentication URLs retire on April 1, 2027 — 13 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 13 November 2026

SharePoint temporary authentication URLs retire on April 1, 2027

The main administrator deadline is the retirement of SharePoint temporary authentication URLs, which will break dependent Power Apps and Automate functionality. Separately, new guidance documents a tenant-level control for restricting agentic users from sharing SharePoint and OneDrive content externally.

SharePoint · General

Power Platform dependencies face a retirement deadline

A Microsoft 365 Message Center notice says SharePoint temporary authentication URLs will be retired on April 1, 2027. Power Apps and Automate functionality that relies on these URLs will break when they are retired, so administrators should review those dependencies ahead of the deadline.

Agents and Copilot · Permissions and governance

Tenant policy restricts agentic external sharing

New Microsoft Learn guidance describes a tenant-level policy for SharePoint and OneDrive that blocks agentic users from sharing content with external users. The policy is off by default and can be enabled through SharePoint Online PowerShell for all agentic users or for users associated with selected application blueprints.

item.title: App Intelligence access reviews documented alongside revised Trim Versions guidance — 11 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 11 November 2026

App Intelligence access reviews documented alongside revised Trim Versions guidance

The November 11 period was documentation-led: Microsoft added a SharePoint governance article describing how administrators can prioritize and investigate non-Microsoft application access, and revised Trim Versions guidance with clearer operational limits and procedures.

SharePoint · Permissions and governance

New workflow covers non-Microsoft application access investigations

The new SharePoint article explains how administrators can prioritize and investigate application access using permissions, site reach, behavior evidence, and privileged-access information. Availability, required roles, licensing, and assessment data vary by tenant and release.

Content and versions · General

Trim Versions guidance now emphasizes the 30-day minimum

The revised article identifies SharePoint Administrators as able to queue trim jobs, simplifies What-if and manual-expiration guidance, highlights the 30-day minimum, and removes the previous text about versions created before January 1, 2023.

SharePoint · Permissions and governance

OneDrive video sharing in Teams events

Microsoft Teams will let event organizers and producers share videos directly from OneDrive using “Manage what attendees see,” avoiding screen sharing or embedding videos in PowerPoint and supporting smoother, higher-quality playback. Rollout begins in mid-November 2026, with no action required.

Sites and intranet · Planning and deployment

Global navigation guidance adds feature and rollout detail

The SharePoint app-bar setup page now describes personalized favorites and recents, quick access to Discover, Publish, Build, and OneDrive, and clarifies global-navigation requirements, permissions, Teams integration, and the possible 24-hour rollout delay.

item.title: Sensitivity-labeled PDFs gain web annotation in OneDrive and SharePoint in January 2027 — 9 November 2026
item.description:
Day in brief · 9 November 2026

Sensitivity-labeled PDFs gain web annotation in OneDrive and SharePoint in January 2027

OneDrive for Business and SharePoint on the web are scheduled to let users with editing rights annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs without removing their labels. Saved files will retain both annotations and protections, with worldwide rollout planned for late January 2027.

SharePoint · General

Editing rights will include annotation of protected PDFs

Users with editing rights will be able to annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs on the web without removing the labels. Annotations and protections will be preserved when the file is saved; worldwide rollout is planned for late January 2027.
